methodology.token_census: Case-insensitive CSS text inspected offline, custom-property names classified by generic semantic prefixes. Classes are heuristic labels, not site-authored component ownership.
methodology.condition_census: Bounded media and container at-rule prelude scanning; repeated/nested and complex conditions may be excluded. Counts of different query groups overlap.
methodology.privacy: Aggregate numeric findings only; no source CSS, class names, identifiers, selectors, breakpoints, file paths, account state, captured URLs or third-party assets published.

tokens.interpretation: Unmatched var() names may come from runtime injection, external/missing CSS, root inheritance or unresolved conditions; they are not proven missing styles.

responsive.unit_scope: Width buckets cover only simple px-valued expressions matched in bounded preludes; not all thresholds, rem/em widths or actual layout breakpoints.

limitations: These are static source counts, not computed style declarations or rendered animation instances.
Query families overlap and bounded-prelude scans can exclude complex forms; at-rule lexical totals use a different counting method.
Heuristic token families do not establish which component owns a variable.
Runtime prefers-color-scheme, reduced-motion settings and cascade results were not observed.
